description: Make a layer's mask from a colour range (Properties panel, masks: Color Range): a sampled colour with a fuzziness, or a preset range such as reds, highlights or skin tones. Replaces the layer's existing mask

color.description: sampled: the colour to keep. "#RRGGBB", "rgb(r,g,b)" (0-255), "cmyk(c,m,y,k)" (0-100), "gray(g)" (0-100, 100 = black), "hsb(h,s,b)" (0-360, 0-100, 0-100) or "lab(L,a,b)"

fuzziness.description: sampled: how far from the colour still counts. Default 40

invert.description: Mask out the range instead of keeping it

target.description: One layer. Default the active layer

names.description: Layer names (every layer with each name)

name: mask_by_color_range
title: Mask By Color Range
